crossRefs.note: Therefore Yahweh his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria. They struck him, and carried away from him a…
For again the Edomites had come and struck Judah, and carried away captives.
I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and…
Our fathers sinned, and are no more. We have borne their iniquities.

translations.web: For, behold, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.
translations.bsb: For behold, this is why our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and daughters and wives are in captivity.
translations.kjv: For, lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.
translations.asv: For, lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.
